answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and receives a Semaphore membership witness and RLN rate-limit key. It evaluates the epoch polynomial and commits to a private identity without exposing it. If the agent sends duplicate messages under one epoch, the resulting polynomial points reveal distinct shares of the same secret; Shamir reconstruction recovers the private key, allowing any verifier to prove the violation and trigger instantaneous collateral slashing across ocean, jade, or forge channels.
